chunks: And yet they worship besides God what cannot bring them gain or do them harm. The unbeliever has always been an auxiliary against his Lord.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that the disbeliever is an auxiliary against his Lord?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the logical absurdity of idolatry, where the created is elevated to the status of the Creator despite possessing no independent agency. The term 'helper' (ẓahīr) implies that the idol acts as a supporting force for the disbeliever’s defiance, effectively turning the worshipper into an ally of his own spiritual ruin against Allah.
